name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a junior silver-gold developer advancing the Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta province, Argentina. The project is fully permitted with a completed definitive feasibility study, positioning it as a primary silver-gold deposit targeting first production in 2029. The company also trades on the OTCQX under the ticker ABBRF.
